# Sample transaction file for the ledger project.
# Amounts are decimal with at most two fraction digits.

open alice 100.00
open bob
open carol 5.5

deposit alice 25.50
transfer alice bob 40
withdraw bob 10
transfer carol alice 1.25

# Problems below: each line fails, processing continues.
withdraw carol 100
deposit dave 5
open alice 1
transfer bob bob 1
deposit bob -3
refund alice 2
transfer alice bob

withdraw bob 0.5
